title: CW laser
description: Uses experiments’ CWLaser complex envelope. RIN and phase noise have separate switches. Optical probes include power and unwrapped phase; no phase-to-intensity conversion is assumed.

params.name: wavelength_nm
params.description: Carrier wavelength; optical metadata, not sampled carrier oscillation.

params.name: fs
params.description: Sample rate; match rate × 10^9 × sps of electrical sources.

params.name: rin_enabled
params.description: Enables laser intensity fluctuations only with global noise on.

params.name: rin_db_hz
params.description: One-sided RIN density. Linearized Gaussian power model; invalid negative-power realizations are rejected.

params.name: linewidth_enabled
params.description: Enables phase diffusion only with global noise on.

params.name: linewidth_hz
params.description: Lorentzian linewidth: phase-increment variance 2π linewidth/fs. Direct power detection is phase insensitive.

params.name: seed
params.description: Block seed offset. Combined with run seed and instance ID; integer 0..2^32-1.
